falsifiers.F_push_main: a push to refs/heads/main (the release PR merge) runs publish-image or deploy: fence_eval scenario 'push main' must SKIP both (it RUNs both on the base file: fence_eval.base-e999e62.log)
falsifiers.F_unadmitted_dispatch: a dispatch with no/other expected_head_sha, an empty reason, or from a non-main ref runs either job (act) or passes the in-job admission (bash)
falsifiers.F_case_fold: GitHub `==` is case-insensitive, so an uppercased sha passes the job `if`; the bash admission must refuse it with REFUSED[HEAD_MOVED] (steps_eval)
falsifiers.F_unreceipted: an admitted publication/deployment ends without a receipt artifact: receipt + upload steps run under always() once admission succeeded, including after a failed actuation step (standing UNKNOWN), and publication ALIVE requires the registry to serve the pushed digest
falsifiers.F_scope: any job other than publish-image/deploy, or any trigger other than workflow_dispatch, changes (conserve.py)
